title: Design Brief frontmatter
description: Structural contract for `_context/planning/design-brief-v{N}.md`. Produced by `design-brief` skill (Phase 5); consumed by `ux-design`, `brand-guidelines`, `prototype`, `narrative`, `legacy-ui-assessment`. Validated-distillate (regeneratable, schema'd, versioned; NOT sacred).

version.description: Monotonically incrementing version. Increment on re-runs (e.g., after PRD reconciliation Phase-5-internal re-author, or persona re-entry result).

mode.description: Operating mode. Shape A only supports bridge mode (PRD + product-brief always present at Phase 5 entry). Standalone removed post-v0.3.

sources.description: Source artefact versions consumed at design-brief authoring time. Used for staleness detection on re-runs.

status.description: Set to 'validated' when Step 4 schema-validation passes and distillate is emitted.

sections.description: Structural inventory of authored sections (used by ux-design + brand-guidelines + prototype to know what's available).

design_deltas_surfaced.description: Count of design_delta entries surfaced during this skill's run (appended to phase-5-design-deltas-wip-{date}.md).

supersede_check_passes.description: Count of supersede-check pair evaluations during the skill (each may produce 0+ deltas).
